mapper.select: select d.id, d.code, d.name, d.parent_id, d.leader, d.sort, (select count(*) from sys_user u where u.dept_id = d.id and u.status = 1) as user_count from sys_dept d order by d.sort, d.id
select d.id, d.code, d.name, d.parent_id, d.leader, d.sort, (select count(*) from sys_user u where u.dept_id = d.id and u.status = 1) as user_count from sys_dept d where d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept (code, name, parent_id, leader, sort) values (#{code}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{leader}, #{sort})
